questionText: [Set 35.18] In the royal centre of the Vijayanagara Empire, the monumental platform known as the 'Mahanavami Dibba' was the focal point for:

options.text: The daily coronation of new imperial sovereigns
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A private crematorium reserved for Vijayanagara queens
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Ritual ceremonies, royal durbars, wrestling contests, and military reviews performed during the ten-day Navaratri/Dussehra festival
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Mahanavami Dibba Monument.

options.text: A grain storage granary constructed to withstand foreign sieges
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Mahanavami Dibba Monument (Vijayanagara Empire: Politics, Economy and Architecture):
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 History (An Imperial Capital: Vijayanagara - Mahanavami Dibba Monument):
The Mahanavami Dibba was a massive pyramidal platform rising from a base of about 11,000 sq ft to a height of 40 ft. Rulers of Vijayanagara celebrated the Mahanavami festival here with state rituals, worship of the state horse, sacrifices, athletic contests, and military reviews.

Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.
